If you have any concerns or questions about your hair service, please contact the salon within two days of appointment date. All concerns and questions will be discussed with the stylist and management. In most cases, we will require a scheduled in person follow up with a senior stylist or salon owner. This appointment will give an opportunity to evaluate the hair and service performed in order to provide available options to meet the client’s expectation while saving the integrity of the hair. Any additional services may require a cost to the client depending on the original service amount. All hair services are non-refundable and the salon cannot guarantee specific results based on factors such as the condition of the hair, previous treatments, and individual differences . We thank you for your understanding regarding these policies. For health and safety reasons, our products can only be returned if they are unopened and unused. Returns must be within 7 days from purchase and will given a credit or exchange towards another product. Gift Cards/ Certificates Ryan M Scottsdale Gift Card Terms and Conditions: 1. Redemption: Gift cards are redeemable only at Ryan M Scottsdale for services or products. 2. Non-Refundable: Gift cards cannot be refunded, returned, or exchanged for cash, except where required by law. 3. Expiration: Gift cards do not expire unless otherwise stated. However, balances must be used in compliance with applicable state laws. 4. Lost or Stolen Cards: Ryan M Scottsdale is not responsible for lost, stolen, damaged, or unauthorized use of gift cards. 5. Non-Transferable: Gift cards are non-transferable and cannot be resold. 6. Partial Use: If the full value is not used in one transaction, the remaining balance will remain on the card for future use. 7. Limitations: Gift cards cannot be used to purchase other gift cards or for gratuity/tips. 8. Additional Fees: No fees will be charged for purchase or maintenance of gift cards. 9. Fraud Protection: Ryan M Scottsdale reserves the right to refuse, deactivate, or cancel gift cards if fraud, tampering, or unauthorized use is suspected. 10. Legal Compliance: Use of gift cards is subject to all applicable local, state, and federal laws. Disclaimer: By purchasing or using a gift card, you agree to these terms and conditions. Ryan M Scottsdale reserves the right to amend these terms at any time, subject to applicable laws. Privacy Policy Protecting your privacy and security is very important to Ryan M Scottsdale. Your personal information will be used lawfully and in accordance with the Data Protection and Spams Act. This Privacy Policy briefly explains how we manage any personal information collected and how it is used. In addition to this Policy, please read our Disclaimer and Terms of Use in full. We collect personal information from you to conduct the following: Respond to all email inquiries Email databases for our email newsletter, updates, and promotions Feedback databases to ensure a high level of customer service For market research purposes To form part of Ryan M Scottsdale customer database To contact you and answer any inquiries you may have Any purposes for which it was requested The type of information we may gather from you includes the following: Your name Address Email address Phone number Details on the type of inquiry/request Brief on goods and services you request How you heard about us Budget requirements We will assume you consent to the management of your personal information in the manner specified in this Privacy Policy (which may be updated from time to time) unless otherwise specified by you (please find contact details below). Your personal information will be held securely in accordance with the law and our internal security policy. By providing your email address, you are consenting to us contacting you via email. Please provide your phone number, if this is your preferred form of contact. When you visit our website, some information we and/or our contractors collect about your visit is not deemed as personal information as your identity is not revealed or stored. Information of this nature can include the following: 1. Site visit data: When you visit our website, we and/or our contractors collect general information about your visit which may include the date and time of your visit, the pages you accessed, your server address, the information you downloaded/accessed, and the type of search engine you used. We and/or our contractors may use this information in anonymous, aggregated form, for statistical purposes only, to assist us in improving the quality and usability of our website. 2. Cookies: Cookies can be stored on your computer, contain an expiration date, and are mainly for the user’s convenience. Most Internet browsers can be set to accept or reject cookies. If you do not want to accept cookies, you can adjust your Internet browser to reject cookies or to notify you when they are being used. If you have any questions or queries or to unsubscribe, please contact us at: Email: kim@ryanmscottsdale.com Address: 15446 N GREENWAY HAYDEN LOOP, SUITE 1010 SCOTTSDALE, AZ 85260 You may also contact us at the details provided above to check the information that we hold about you. Fun fact: Ryan opened his first salon at just 21 years old, and within five years it was named one of the Top 10 Salons in the USA by New Beauty Magazine. Read more. Ryan Mckinley — RYAN M SCOTTSDALE HOME SERVICES OUR STYLISTS PRODUCTS CONTACT TERMS Online Gift Cards BOOK APPOINTMENT HOME SERVICES OUR STYLISTS PRODUCTS CONTACT TERMS Go-To Lux Scottsdale Salon Online Gift Cards BOOK APPOINTMENT / Ryan Mckinley / Master Stylist Ryan Mckinley is… …the proudly passionate owner and top stylist to his namesake, Ryan M Scottsdale. Working over 20 years in the beauty industry, his journey began at 18 by leaving his hometown of Salt Lake City, Utah with big dreams and a full heart to embark on his beauty career. His acceptance into the esteemed Vidal Sassoon Academy in Santa Monica, California propelled him into the most sought-after assistant program in Beverly Hills where he mentored under Hollywood’s most elite celebrity stylists of the time. After spending 3 years in California, he moved back home to open his first salon which doubled in size in two years. In 5 years, it was awarded the number one salon in Salt Lake City and featured in New Beauty Magazine as one of the 10 best salons in the USA! During this time Ryan became a platform artist for Tony and Guy as well as educating for some of the best brands in the business. At the 7-year mark, he had conquered the beauty industry of Utah and was ready for something bigger. On a winter vacation to visit friends in Scottsdale, everything fell into place. Chance had it, during this trip, Ryan was randomly introduced to the owner of Scottsdale’s busiest salon at the time. The owner was exceptionally talented with a robust clientele. He happened to be in search of someone with the total package; personality and skill, to take on his clients as his equal and become his colorist. Ryan partnered with the owner, then sold his salon in Utah and moved his family to Scottsdale. The next 10 years flew by in a blink. Over that time, he learned not only how to be the top stylist to Scottsdale’s most elite, but how to be a successful businessman while making the most money possible working behind the chair. Ryan learned the importance of working with an assistant and double booking to maximize himself. During the course of those ten years, he trained 7 assistants who have gone on to become masters of their craft as well. After the owner’s sudden passing, Ryan felt it was time to start out again on his own with all of his wisdom and experience to create Ryan M. Scottsdale. With a culmination of hard work and great excitement, we give to you Ryan M Scottsdale, at The District at the Quarter. View this profile on Instagram Ryan M.
